title: Polynomial-Time Computability of the Tail-Link Fragment
statement: There exist a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and natural numbers $C,c$ such that, for every Boolean word $z$, $M$ halts after exactly $C(|z|+1)^c$ steps with output equal to the tail-link fragment formed from $z$.
replaced:
The tail-link fragment function on round requests is polynomial-time computable,
built by a fixed number of polynomial-time concatenations.
